jobs.occupation: Take your nursing career to Northern Norway
jobs.description: Imagine building your nursing career in one of Europe’s most spectacular regions, surrounded by Arctic nature, close-knit communities and a healthcare system where your skills are truly valued.We are recruiting EU-trained nurses for permanent positions in municipal healthcare services in Finnmark, Northern Norway. You will mainly work within home care services or nursing homes, providing important care and becoming part of an experienced and supportive healthcare team.Moving to another country is a big step, but you will not have to do it alone. Chef Wanted for Sommarøy - Seasonal Position with Possibility of Extension
Would you like to work as a chef in the beautiful surroundings of Sommarøy, just outside Tromsø? We are currently looking for a skilled and dedicated chef to join our team at Sommarøy Hotel for an exciting seasonal position.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working in a kitchen, takes pride in using quality ingredients, and would love to combine work with unforgettable nature experiences in Northern Norway.

The position is full-time (100%), starting in November and running until the end of March, with the possibility of extension.

• Ensuring high standards of food quality and presentation.

• Working closely with the kitchen team and other departments.
• Contributing to a positive working environment and excellent guest experiences.Qualifications
• Experience as a chef in a hotel, restaurant, or similar establishment.
• Experience with à la carte service.

• An exciting working environment surrounded by spectacular natural scenery.
• A friendly and international working environment.

• The opportunity to experience Northern Norway, with spectacular landscapes and the Northern Lights right on your doorstep.About Sommarøy Hotel
Sommarøy Hotel is situated in the scenic surroundings of Sommarøy, approximately a one-hour drive from Tromsø. Surrounded by the sea, mountains, and beautiful Northern Norwegian nature, the hotel attracts guests looking for unique experiences throughout the year.

Here, you will have the opportunity to become part of a kitchen team dedicated to creating memorable dining experiences for our guests.
Interested?

Your main tasks will be tractor and machinery operation, including soil preparation, planting, and cultivation. Other duties include:

· Moving and handling irrigation equipment

· Daily checks and basic maintenance of machinery

· Transporting vegetables from the fields to cooling and storage facilities

· Loading and unloading produce and equipment

· Helping with planting, harvesting, and other physical farm work when needed

What we are looking for

· Experience operating tractors and agricultural machinery

· A valid driving licence: category T, C, or BE

· Ability to speak and understand English

· Someone who works independently, takes care of equipment, and is willing to help with different tasks

What we offer

· Seasonal employment from April to September 2027

· NOK 190--215 per hour before tax, depending on experience and qualifications

In ENGLISH:

Professional Drivers Wanted – Bus, Minibus, Truck.

Location: Finnsnes, Troms, Northern Norway

Ulf Trulsen AS, Senja Tours and Finnsnes Termotransport are looking for skilled and reliable professional drivers to join our operations in Finnsnes.

We are looking for

• Bus drivers – Category D for coach/tour bus and passenger transport

• Minibus drivers – Category D1

• Truck drivers – Category C/CE for freight transport, distribution and long-haul transport

Flexible shift and rotation schedules

We offer several work arrangements and aim to find a solution that suits each individual driver:

• Full-time positions with regular working hours

• 14/14 rotation – 14 days working / 14 days off

• Monthly rotation – one month working / one month off

• Other rotation schedules by agreement

Our rotation schedules are particularly suitable for drivers who wish to commute between their home country and Norway, while enjoying longer periods of time off.

Accommodation and housing

We can assist drivers who wish to relocate to Norway in finding accommodation in the Finnsnes area.

For drivers who prefer to commute, we can also look into affordable accommodation during working periods, such as:

• Rooms

• Apartments

• Modular accommodation

• Other suitable housing solutions

Our goal is to make it as easy as possible to combine working with us with living and family life in your home country.

We help you with the transition to Norway

For candidates from the Nordic countries and EU/EEA, we can provide guidance and practical assistance with matters related to starting work in Norway, including:

• Driving licences and Driver CPC / YSK

• Norwegian rules and requirements

• Tax registration

• Housing and accommodation

• Other practical and administrative matters

We assess each candidate individually and aim to find good solutions regarding work arrangements, rotation schedules, accommodation and commuting.

About Finnsnes

Finnsnes is located in Senja Municipality in Troms, Northern Norway, and is an important transport and regional centre in Mid-Troms. The area offers spectacular Northern Norwegian nature, while Finnsnes has an active business community and good local services.

We are looking for someone who

• Holds a Category D, D1, C or CE driving licence, depending on the position

• Holds the required Driver CPC / YSK

• Is a safe and responsible driver

• Is service-minded and professional

• Works well independently and is flexible

• Speaks Norwegian (or another Scandinavian langiage) and/or English

Previous professional driving experience is an advantage.

Interested?

Please send us your CV and a short introduction about yourself. Let us know which driving license category you hold, what type of driving you are interested in, and whether you are looking for a full-time position, rotation work or a commuting arrangement.

We welcome qualified drivers from Norway, the Nordic countries and the EU/EEA to apply.

Location: Finnsnes, Troms, Norway

Positions: D / D1 / C / CE

Work arrangements: Full-time and various rotation schedules

Start date: By agreement

jobs.description:
Electricians (Group L) / Traveling Electricians Wanted for an Exciting Data Center Project – 14/14 Rotation!
Would you like to be part of building a new, modern data center in Norway?

 

We are looking for skilled and qualified electricians to join an exciting, long-term project offering competitive salaries, an attractive 14/14 rotation schedule, and free accommodation!

 

On behalf of our client, a well-established and growing company, we are recruiting qualified electricians and traveling electricians for a major data center construction project.

This is an excellent opportunity to become part of a large-scale, technically challenging construction project that is expected to continue for several years.

 

You will have the opportunity to develop your professional skills, work with modern electrical installations, and contribute to the development of essential infrastructure for the future.

The position is project-based but offers long-term prospects and excellent opportunities for continuous employment over several years.
What We Offer
• 14/14 rotation schedule – 14 days of work followed by 14 consecutive days off.
• Competitive salary and attractive financial conditions.
• Free accommodation – accommodation costs are covered by the employer during working periods.
• Opportunity to participate in the construction of a new, modern data center.
• Long-term project expected to last several years.
• Varied and technically challenging tasks.
• Excellent opportunities for professional development and valuable project experience.
• Pension and insurance benefits.
• A professional, international, and inclusive working environment with experienced colleagues.Main Responsibilities
• Perform electrical installations as part of the construction of a new data center.
• Install and assemble electrical systems and technical equipment.
• Carry out cable pulling, electrical connections, and other electrical installation work.
• Cooperate with other trades and professionals on a large-scale construction project.
• Ensure that all work complies with applicable regulations, quality requirements, and Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) standards.Qualifications
• Norwegian Electrician Trade Certificate (Group L) or valid DSB approval.
• Valid FSE certification.
• Experience with electrical installations, preferably from large industrial or construction projects.
• Valid Category B driving licence.
• Norwegian or English
• Flexibility and motivation to work on a 14/14 rotation schedule.Personal Qualities
• Responsible, reliable, and punctual.
• Independent, well-organized, and solution-oriented.
• Quality-conscious with a strong focus on workplace safety and HSE.
• Good teamwork and communication skills.
• Positive attitude and motivation to contribute to a long-term project.Interested? Apply Today!
This is a fantastic opportunity for electricians looking for competitive pay, an attractive rotation schedule, and the chance to participate in a major data center construction project lasting several years.

 

You will gain valuable experience working on a modern technology infrastructure project while enjoying 14 consecutive days off between working periods.

 

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible!

Please send your CV and application to jelizaveta@job4u.no, using the subject line "Electrician – Data Center".
Contact Information
Jelizaveta JefimenkoJob4u.no AS

Phone: +47 468 80 060Email: jelizaveta@job4u.no

jobs.description: Would you like to combine a meaningful job with proximity to stunning nature?We are recruiting registered nurses for permanent full-time positions within municipal healthcare services in Western Norway.The positions are connected to nursing homes and home-based care services, where you will have the opportunity to work closely with patients and contribute to safe, high-quality healthcare services.The workplace is beautifully located between fjords, high mountains and spectacular scenery.
